# Delegated task brief

- Issue and human owner:
- Base commit and isolated jo/ worktree:
- Concrete failure or intended outcome (reproduction/evidence):
- Allowed files/interfaces; forbidden scope:
- Dependencies and known concurrent work:
- Acceptance: normal, boundary, invalid and regression cases, plus positive controls:
- Tests-first command and expected behavioral failure:
- Required focused/full/native/browser checks:
- Runtime, credit limit and stop conditions:
- Output: reviewable diff + docs/templates/task-handoff.md; no push/merge/issue closure unless explicitly authorized.

One issue/slice only. Record incomplete parent acceptance separately. Stop on a genuine missing shared-interface decision; do not invent a permissive contract to get green tests.
